releases.notes:
Ports Wildbound to the official **Minecraft 26.3** release.

## Changes
- Advancement-predicate system update: `ContextAwarePredicate` folded into the loot-condition system
  (`Optional<Holder<LootItemCondition>>` replaces it on every trigger's `player` field).
- `LivingEntity.drop` now takes a required `Prediction` arg; the bound-cluster's inventory-full fallback
  uses `SERVER_ONLY`, matching vanilla's own server-driven give-or-drop call sites.
- No gameplay changes — same companions, same mechanics as 1.3.0.

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.3 · Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ · Fabric API · Java 25+

Play-tested in-client (sheep riding, bat perch) in addition to the headless gametest suite.

releases.notes:
A twelfth companion joins the menagerie: the **Strider**.

## Highlights

- **Strider** — tamed the same way as every other animal (one amethyst shard, no new item), grants **Fire Resistance I** while following. It still shivers and slows down off lava like vanilla, and that's by design: a player who wants a Strider companion is already living near lava, and a **bound cluster** carries it across any dry stretch in between — the same accepted trade-off the aquatic companions (axolotl, turtle) already lean on.
- The advancement tree grows with it: a new *Fireproof Friendship* advancement, and *The Wild Knows Your Name* now requires all **twelve** kinds.
- Docs cleanup alongside it: `docs/design.md`'s Scope section now frames hostile/neutral companions as the actively planned next phase rather than a "maybe someday" footnote, and calls out client-side code as an accepted cost of a companion's mechanic (as the rideable sheep already is) rather than an exception.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.2** · Fabric Loader **0.19.3+** · **Fabric API** · Java **25+**
- Install on the **server and the client** — riding the sheep needs the client side; everything else works for vanilla clients.

## Verification

- Play-tested in-client: taming, following, and Fire Resistance delivery all confirmed.
- Headless `runServer` boots clean (`Wildbound initialised with 12 companion type(s)`, no mixin-apply failures).
- Full `./gradlew build` GameTest suite passes (7/7).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/atperry7/wildbound/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0

releases.notes:
Wildbound now runs on the official **Minecraft 26.2** release.

### Changes
- **Ported to MC 26.2.** Internal API moves only — advancement criterion classes, `EntityType` spawn constants, and the `EntityType.create` spawn-request shape. No gameplay changes; saves and bound clusters carry over.
- Built against the **26.2 floor**: Fabric Loader `0.19.3`, Fabric API `0.152.1+26.2`, Java `25`.

### Install
Drop the jar in `mods/` on **both server and client** (riding the sheep needs the client; everything else is server-driven and works for vanilla clients). Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ and Fabric API.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/atperry7/wildbound/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

releases.notes:
Wildbound now runs on **every Minecraft 26.1.x version** — 26.1, 26.1.1, and 26.1.2 — from this one jar (1.0.0 required 26.1.2 exactly). No gameplay changes.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API (any build for your MC version)
- Java 25+
- Install on server and client (sheep riding needs the client side; everything else works for vanilla clients)

**Verification**
- Booted and verified headlessly on all three game versions (clean mixin apply, full datapack load).
- New in this release under the hood: an automated behaviour-test suite (taming, mode toggles, milk quiet, passive delivery, capture/release) now runs on a real test server in CI for every change.

**For 26.2 players:** see the [1.2.0-beta.1 pre-release](https://github.com/atperry7/wildbound/releases/tag/v1.2.0-beta.1) built for 26.2-rc-1.

releases.notes:
Pre-release build of the 26.2 port (`port/26.2`, commit ca7d03e + version bump) for play-testing against Minecraft **26.2-rc-1**.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 26.2-rc-1 (loader range is `>=26.2-rc.1 <26.3`, so it will also load on 26.2 final)
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API **0.152.0+26.2** (a 26.1-branch Fabric API will not run on 26.2)
- Java 25+
- Install on server and client (sheep riding needs the client side)

**Verification status**
- All 7 headless gametests pass on 26.2-rc-1: taming, mode toggles, milk quiet, passive delivery, capture/release — mixins apply cleanly.
- **Not yet play-tested in-client** — that's what this build is for. The items the gametests can't see:
  - Sheep riding feel (mount on plain right-click, ridden control, jumping)
  - Bat perch/rest behaviour (settle height on ground perches)
  - Fox item-fetch
  - Mode-toggle particle/sound cues, passive HUD icon visibility
- Known cosmetic-risk item: `Item.appendHoverText` is deprecated in 26.2 (still functional) — check the bound cluster's tooltip renders.

⚠️ Built against a release candidate; worlds touched by an RC may not be safe for your main saves. Test on a throwaway world.
